, , ( ) ashtami men banaen swaadisht & healthy Halwa, Chana & Puri. This combination is a masterclass in ancient Ayurvedic nutrition. After days of strict Sattvik fasting, the body requires an immediate but gentle & balanced nutritional reboot. Puris provide carbs, ghee (in the Halwa) provides energy and good fat, Chana of course, is high protein. Can you think of a better balance than this? :)
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 25-30 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Boiling Chana
2-3 tbsp Ghee, ghi
Water as required, pani
